<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012025-04-2915-41-42" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:yid_dpyod">
      <milestone unit="section" n="112.223.1 yid spyod kyi mtshan nyid"/>
        dang po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3834">gzhan dag</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs></note> na re myong ba dang rtags la ma brten <lb n="10a7"/> par don mtha' 1 tu nges pa zhes zer te | 'di rigs pa ma yin de ltar na sgra rtag par zhen pa'i rang log shes kyi rang ldog 'di 'ang yid spyod du 'gyur | 'dod na yul bden pa dang ldan par <expan>thal lo</expan> | des na yid spyod kyi tha snyad du mtshon pa'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> ni myong ba dang rtags la ma rten par sngar ma rtogs pa'i don bden pa nges pa'o |</seg></TEI>
